slides.headline: CHATGPT'S BIGGEST RIVAL JUST MADE YOUR AI 40% CHEAPER AND ACTUALLY BETTER
slides.image_prompt: Dario Amodei triumphant and confident, Sam Altman looking shocked and worried, with the Claude logo and OpenAI logo in big circles next to them

caption:
Claude just got 40% cheaper, 30% faster, and smarter all at once, and subscribers got free credits to pocket. 🤯

There's always been one rule in tech: better costs more. Every upgrade, every new plan, every new model has worked exactly that way. You either pay more or you get less.

Anthropic just broke the rule. The new version of Claude costs 40% less than the old one, outputs answers 30% faster, and outperforms the version it replaced. Not one of those things. All three. At the same time.

But the part people are really talking about is the free credits. Every subscriber gets a rate limit reset they can save and spend whenever they want. Like finding a $20 in a jacket pocket you forgot about, except it never disappears until you choose to use it. The week you actually need Claude working extra hard for you, that's when you pull it out.

OpenAI is now sitting across the table trying to explain why their paying customers should stay. This is the first time an AI subscription got cheaper, faster, and smarter all at once, and OpenAI has no good answer for it.

AI just got cheaper. And it got cheaper while the quality went up. Every AI subscription out there now has to answer the same question: why should someone pay more for yours?

Running a business? DM us "AI" and we'll show you what this shift could mean for your tools.

Sources: Anthropic, kimmonismus on X
